subject: Post-demo: Procurement portal access, PO timing & econ buyer confirmation

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@mediwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Procurement portal access, PO timing & econ buyer confirmation

Hi Lina —

Thanks again for your time on the demo this morning. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can keep the procurement thread moving: 

1) Stakeholders: you mentioned Tom Harris (Finance) is the final approver for POs and Sara Mehta in Legal will sign the contract. Can you confirm Tom's preferred email and whether Sara should be looped now or later?

2) Vendor intake: does MediWell require vendor portal onboarding, or is a simple vendor packet + W9 sufficient? If portal access is required, could you share the portal link and the contact on your side who manages vendor registrations?

3) PO timing: you called out a mid-August billing window for new vendors. Is that the earliest expected PO date, or is there a rush path we should be aware of?

Attachments: I attached a one-page vendor packet template and our preliminary SOW (v0.2) so your ops/finance team can validate the fields we’ll need for invoicing.

Next steps from our side: Marissa will prepare a stripped-down vendor packet (filled with the minimum required fields) and Ben can confirm billing contact and invoicing cadence.

Appreciate any pointers on the portal or contact names and I’ll coordinate the docs.

Best,

Irene Choi
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: mediwell_vendor_packet.pdf (stub), redwood_sow_v0.2.docx (stub)
From: Lina Park <lina.park@mediwell.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procure@mediwell.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Procurement portal access, PO timing & econ buyer confirmation

Irene —

Thanks for the tidy recap. A few answers below: 

- Tom Harris (Finance) is indeed the econ buyer for this spend. Best contact: tharris@mediwell.com. He prefers to be looped once pricing and SOW are final.
- Legal: Sara Mehta (sara.mehta@mediwell.com) should be looped when you have the final SOW + contract redlines.
- Vendor intake: we do have a vendor portal (VendorNet). The vendor onboarding team manages it — I've copied procure@mediwell.com. For initial intake we accept a vendor packet + W9; portal onboarding usually happens after the vendor is approved (2–3 business days once procurement creates the vendor record).
- PO timing: mid-August is the target for next quarter budgeting, but Finance can sometimes approve an off-cycle PO if we have the vendor record in place and a clear SOW. Tom will confirm whether he can expedite.

I'll look for the streamlined packet from your team. If you want, Procure can send a portal invite once you provide the vendor company details.

Best,

Lina Park
Senior Product Manager, MediWell
lina.park@mediwell.com

Thanks for the clarity. I've attached a pared-down vendor packet with only the fields you indicated are required (company legal name, tax ID, remit-to address, AP contact, W9). Please confirm if the AP contact needs to be a dedicated email or if a shared mailbox is acceptable.

Irene: filing this under action items for us — Ben, can you confirm our remit-to and standard invoice terms? Also flagging the compliance summary for Sara/Legal to review after we finalize pricing.

Quick note from Finance: if Redwood can provide the vendor packet + completed W9 by EOD Wednesday (14 Jul), I can push for an expedited vendor record and a procurement approval meeting on Friday (15 Jul). That would put us in a position to issue an off-cycle PO for onboarding work and pilot invoices, which helps get the pilot started in advance of the mid-August cycle.

Also: our AP team prefers invoice PDFs with the PO number on the first page and payment terms net 30 by default. If you need a faster payment schedule for pilot invoices we can discuss on the approval call.
